title: Marus
summary: Raleigh names Marus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Marus, also called Menides, whom Diodorus makes the builder of the Labyrinth, fiue generations before Proteus. Reineccius takes him for Annemenes. Raleigh doth not, and coniectures that he was one of the twelue Princes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
